name: pixelfriend-monorepo
description: PixelFriend: a hydration buddy for VS Code (pixelfriend/), its macOS menu bar companion Activ (activ/), and the shared cartoon character engine (character/).

scripts.build: npm run build:character && npm run build:extension && npm run build:activ
scripts.build:character: npm run build --workspace character && cp character/dist/character.bundle.js pixelfriend/media/character/
